topic: Job interview roleplay: checking in at reception

vars.staffOpen: Good morning! Are you here for an interview?
vars.learnerLine: Hi, I'm Mia Chen. I have an interview with Ms. Park at ten.
vars.staffReply: Thanks, Ms. Chen. Please have a seat. She'll be out in a minute.
vars.tip: say your name, who you're meeting, and the time. That's all reception needs.
